# Câu (f): MANOVA hai nhân tố (Attrition × OverTime)

```{r f-du-lieu}
# Dữ liệu sạch từ câu (a)
ea_f <- read.csv(here::here("data", "processed", "DataEA_clean.csv"))
ea_f$Attrition <- factor(ea_f$Attrition, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
ea_f$OverTime  <- factor(ea_f$OverTime,  levels = c("No", "Yes"))

bien_tl <- c("JobSatisfaction", "EnvironmentSatisfaction", "WorkLifeBalance", "JobInvolvement")
Y_f <- as.matrix(ea_f[, bien_tl])
o_f <- interaction(ea_f$Attrition, ea_f$OverTime, sep = ".")   # 4 ô
knitr::kable(table(Attrition = ea_f$Attrition, OverTime = ea_f$OverTime))
```
